entries.german: Dekan Johannes von Mainz bekundet, daß er mit den Rittern: Conrad Schenk von Erbach (-pach); Ebirhard von Rosenberg; Gotfrid gen. Stahel; Marschall Johannes von Waldeck; Conrad gen. Rüdt (Ruede), Burggraf in Starkenburg (-kin-); und anderen Freunden des Erzbischofs von Mainz, vom 1. Dez. (fer. II. post diem b. Andree proxima) abends (de sero) bis zum 4. Dez. (fer. V. immediate sequentem) nach dem Frühstück (facto prandio) sich in (opido) Bensheim für den Erzbischof mit den Freunden der Herzöge von Bayern aufgehalten und dabei an Geld 20 Pfd. 17 Heller ausgegeben und (de provisione domini nostri) in pane 9 Mltr. siliginis, in vino franco 4 amas, in hunico 25 quartalia, in pabulo 21 Mltr. cum 3 sum. avene verbraucht hat. Der erzb. Kellner Jakob in Starkenburg (-kin-) hat von Amtswegen (ratione officii sui) dies alles geliefert und erhält darüber diese Urk.
entries.english: Dean Johannes of Mainz declares that with the knights: Conrad Schenk von Erbach (-pach); Eberhard von Rosenberg; Gotfrid called Stahel; Marshal Johannes von Waldeck; Conrad called Rüdt (Ruede), burgrave in Starkenburg (-kin-); and other friends of the Archbishop of Mainz, he remained from December 1 (Tuesday after the feast of St. Andrew) evening (de sero) until December 4 (Friday immediately following) after breakfast (facto prandio) in the town of Bensheim on behalf of the Archbishop with the friends of the Dukes of Bavaria, and thereby spent 20 pounds 17 Heller in money and (of the provision of our lord) consumed 9 measures of rye flour in bread, 4 amas of French wine, 25 quartalia of millet, and 21 measures with 3 sum. of oats in fodder. The archiepiscopal cellarer Jakob in Starkenburg (-kin-) has supplied all this by virtue of his office (ratione officii sui) and receives this document regarding it.

facts.content: was at Bensheim with the dean of Mainz and other friends of the archbishop to meet friends of the dukes of Bavaria.
